post.caption: Apatite's name means to deceive. It comes from the Greek apatao, since experts kept misclassifying it. It was long mistaken for beryl and tourmaline. A clear green kind is called asparagus stone. In the mid 1990s, neon blue apatite from Madagascar appeared. It resembles Paraiba tourmaline at a far lower price. Most vivid blue apatite is made by gently heating green stones. Apatite defines number 5 on the Mohs scale. At that softness it suits earrings and pendants better than rings. Tooth enamel is mostly hydroxyapatite, a member of the apatite family. Water was found locked inside apatite in Moon rocks from Apollo.
